verdict.rationale: Codegen offers a TUI and web interface to view agents, browse runs, and retrieve detailed execution logs/traces (thought process, tool usage) via API, plus Slack progress updates, which together approximate real-time oversight of agent status. However, there is no explicit evidence of a live streaming view of an in-progress agent's current action (vs. polling logs/traces after the fact) or a dashboard showing real-time status updates as they happen. missing for 10: evidence of true real-time/live streaming of agent activity as it happens, a persistent status indicator during execution, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the monitoring UX.
